Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner applied an ad-hoc rule equating nationality with present-day birthplace and concluded “French,” despite authoritative sources and historical convention identifying Frederick I Barbarossa (Beatrice I’s husband) as a German king/Holy Roman Emperor. This contradicted the prior correct understanding (“German”) and cited place-based pages (Haguenau) rather than sources establishing his nationality.
